reference: Claude Code 2.1.283 embedded declarations and previously extracted implementation
profileClaim: Bounded desktop adapters; not complete upstream parity

implemented.name: registration-provider-diagnostics
implemented.behavior: Distinguishes package validity from installed production event providers. Exact metadata-only or missing events are unsupported. Broad observers report partial coverage without disabling working events. Unknown custom providers and empty registrations remain unverified.
implemented.limits: Does not analyze all SDK calls, matcher reachability, cross-plugin engine availability, business outcome or complete 2.1.283 declarations.

implemented.name: explicit-desktop-compatibility-check
implemented.behavior: Checks immutable source digest in an isolated registration VM on explicit request. Does not grant authority or invoke handlers. Serializes checks and rejects stale source/workspace; invalidation and shutdown stop the probe.
implemented.limits: Module initialization and register functions are evaluated under the existing VM limits. No automatic probe runs while polling status.

implemented.name: URL-and-URLSearchParams
implemented.behavior: Locked whatwg-url 14.2.0 pure guest implementation, same-VM lazy initialization and reproducibly generated resource with dependency licenses. Hooks and Client share standard URL parsing, mutable properties and live iterable parameters, with existing CPU and memory limits.
limits: Not a complete WPT run or differential run against Claude.
Library rejects leading digit plus RTL IDNA hostname accepted by Node 22/24; the difference is explicitly tested.
Very large inputs remain subject to existing VM and UTF-8 budgets.
